thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (prod, gateway). 12:03 UTC window 5m: error-rate 32% -> paging on-call.

alice_oncall: I'm taking pager. Looking at Grafana now — tail latency and 5xx spike align with model-runner errors. Starting live huddle.

ben_sre: seeing repeated container restarts on infer-runner-pool-3 in eu-west-1. Crash loop with exit code 139 (segfault) around the tokenization stage.

carla_runtime: jumping in. Locals show oom messages in node syslog for the runner host:
```
[12:01:45] Out of memory: Kill process 23456 (model_runner) score 987 or sacrifice child
[12:01:45] Killed process 23456 (model_runner) total-vm:10240000kB, anon-rss:8200000kB
```
Looks like a paging/eviction pattern, KV cache growth + long sequences.

alice_oncall: confirm: k8s events show OOMKilled + eviction, pods restarted ~12:01. Gateway measured timeouts starting 12:02.

ben_sre: stack traces from the runner indicate a null deref after a large allocation for attention_caches; segfault backtrace snippet:
```
#0  0x7f2a3e8 in attention::compute(...)
#1  0x7f1b2c4 in kv_cache::apply_prefix
#2  0x400abc in model_runner::handle_request
```
Not a clean reproducible code path yet.

carla_runtime: mitigation plan: 1) scale down heavy KV cache models on eu-west-1 (autoscaler -> 0 for redwood-large-v1), 2) route traffic to fallback small models, 3) drain the two affected nodes and restart kubelet to clear kernel OOM pressure. Initiating step 2 now (traffic reroute).

dan_prodops: I kicked the rollout to fallback route policy (fast-fail to redwood-medium-v2) and enabled region-failover for EU customers. Commands run: `kubectl patch --type=merge routecfg ...` and `trafficctl promote fallback-policy/medium-v2`.

emily_support: customer-impact: Support queue shows 18 reports in the last 15m from EU users — chat UI timeouts and 502 gateway errors. Notifying top 3 enterprise customers via status page update.

frank_cust_success: Noted. Sent proactive emails to 3 impacted accounts. Asked PMs for potential billing credits if this persists >1h.

gina_engineer: minimal hotpatch attempt: pinned model runtime to an older quant kernel on a canary shard to test stability: `modelctl set-bin kernel=quant_v2.1` — canary looks stable (~10m). No segfaults observed on canary yet.

alice_oncall: rolling canary to 20% on eu-west-1 and holding. Monitoring error rate — currently dropped from 32% -> 9% after failover and canary.

ben_sre: collecting core dumps from crashed pods and uploading to s3://redwood-incidents/1759004321/cores. Heap profiles show KV cache RSS growth to ~8GB per model instance on long sequences. Suspect memory leak under certain attention window shapes.

carla_runtime: immediate actions documented:
- keep fallback route active until hotfix validated
- cordon & drain affected nodes, reboot VM to clear kernel fragmentation
- disable auto-prefetch for KV cache on redwood-large-v1
- schedule forced GC and restart window for model_runner processes (staggered)

alice_oncall: handing off to ben_sre and carla_runtime for post-mitigation root-cause and hotfix timeline. I'm stepping off pager in 30m; leave channel for updates.

emily_support: status page updated: "Investigating elevated errors for downstream text generation in EU region. Failover to fallback models in effect; mitigation in progress."

frank_cust_success: summary for customers: Impact window started ~12:01 UTC, primary cause inferred: runtime OOM -> segfault -> pod restarts; mitigation: regional failover and canary hotpatch; current error rate ~9%. Will follow up with RCA once ben/carol have root cause.

gina_engineer: next steps for engineering: reproducible regression test with long-tail context sequences (+stress KV cache), add eviction guardrails (per-request KV cap), and add an alert for rapid RSS growth. Assigning ticket INF-3281.

alice_oncall: thanks team. If error-rate stays <10% and no customer escalations in next 45m, we'll close the active mitigation and move to RCA cadence. Marking incident as "mitigated (failover)" for now.
